title: Greek Chicken Fajitas
description: A twist on traditional Mexican fajitas, featuring chicken cooked with Greek seasonings and served with exotic spices.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, mix together Greek seasoning, exotic spices, and lime juice.
2. Add chicken to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Remove chicken from marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
5. Add chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
6. Add sliced onion and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
7. If using Greek cheese, crumble it over the top of the chicken and vegetables.
8. Serve hot, garnished with additional exotic spices if desired.
